#1、计算LLM与人类评分相关系数
```{r}
#人类评分
human_scores <- llms_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(Rater == "Human") %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant_ID, all_of(Eng_q_names))

#计算 Pearson r（LLM vs 人类均分，按维度）
raters_to_plot <- c(llm_raters2, "LLMs_mean")

compute_r <- function(data, rater_name, human_df, dims) {
  llm_scores <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Rater == rater_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(Participant_ID, all_of(dims))

  merged <- inner_join(human_df, llm_scores,
                       by = "Participant_ID",
                       suffix = c("_human", "_llm"))

  map_dfr(dims, function(dim) {
    h <- merged[[paste0(dim, "_human")]]
    l <- merged[[paste0(dim, "_llm")]]

    ct <- cor.test(h, l, use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")

    tibble(
      Dimension = dim,
      Rater     = rater_name,
      r         = unname(ct$estimate),
      p         = ct$p.value,
      ci_low    = ct$conf.int[1],
      ci_high   = ct$conf.int[2],
      n         = sum(complete.cases(h, l))
    )
  })
}

corr_llms <- map_dfr(raters_to_plot, ~compute_r(llms_analysis, .x, human_scores, Eng_q_names))

# FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg) 校正：把全部 rater x dimension 的检验当作一个整体 family
corr_llms <- corr_llms %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    sig_fdr = p_fdr < 0.05
  )

```

```{r}
write_xlsx(corr_llms, "D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/draft/mini/0903mini_corr.xlsx")
```

```{r}
# x轴=维度，y轴=r；LLM用beeswarm，LLMs_mean单独用大点叠加并向左偏移
# show_legend=FALSE 不显示图例；title_position="bottom" 把类型名当caption放在图底部
plot_correlation_flipped <- function(df, value_col, ylab, title,
                                      show_legend = TRUE, title_position = "top") {

  df_llm  <- df %>% filter(Rater != "LLMs_mean")
  df_mean <- df %>% filter(Rater == "LLMs_mean")

  dim_levels <- levels(factor(df_llm$Dimension))

  df_llm <- df_llm %>%
    mutate(
      Rater      = factor(Rater, levels = names(rater_colors)),
      Dimension  = factor(Dimension, levels = dim_levels),
      Dim_num    = as.numeric(Dimension)
    )

  df_mean <- df_mean %>%
    mutate(
      Rater      = factor(Rater, levels = names(rater_colors)),
      Dimension  = factor(Dimension, levels = dim_levels),
      Dim_num    = as.numeric(Dimension) - 0.3  # LLMs_mean向左偏移
    )

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_beeswarm(
      data = df_llm,
      aes(x = Dim_num, y = .data[[value_col]], color = Rater, shape = Rater),
      cex = 1.5, alpha = 0.9, size = 2.5
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_mean,
      aes(x = Dim_num, y = .data[[value_col]], color = Rater, shape = Rater),
      size = 4, alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = rater_colors) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = rater_shapes) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:length(dim_levels),
      labels = dim_levels
    ) +
    labs(
      title   = if (title_position == "top") title else NULL,
      caption = if (title_position == "bottom") title else NULL,
      y       = ylab,
      x       = NULL,
      color   = NULL,
      shape   = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.line.y      = element_line(),
      axis.line.x      = element_line(),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(),
      legend.position  = if (show_legend) "top" else "none",
      plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.caption     = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")
    )

  if (show_legend) {
    p <- p + guides(
      color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(size = 4)),
      shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2)
    )
  }

  p
}
```

```{r}
p_emotional2 <- plot_correlation_flipped(

)
```

#画图v4：姊妹图，DeepSeek-V4-Flash / Low-cost LLM mean 分别与 Primary LLM mean 的逐条目 ICC，结构跟上面r的对比图完全对称

```{r}
# 两两配对算ICC，跟icc_between_llms/icc_human用的是同一套 icc() 设置（twoway/agreement/average），
# 只是这里固定只配对2个rater：一个是DeepSeek-V4-Flash或Low-cost LLM mean，另一个永远是Primary LLM mean
compute_icc_pair <- function(scores_a, scores_b, dims) {
  merged <- inner_join(scores_a, scores_b, by = "Participant_ID", suffix = c("_a", "_b"))

  map_dfr(dims, function(dim) {
    wide <- merged %>%
      dplyr::select(all_of(paste0(dim, c("_a", "_b")))) %>%
      na.omit()

    result <- icc(wide, model = "twoway", type = "agreement", unit = "average")

    tibble(
      Dimension = dim,
      ICC       = result$value,
      p_value   = result$p.value,
      ICC_lower = result$lbound,
      ICC_upper = result$ubound
    )
  })
}

deepseek_scores <- llms_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(Rater == "DeepSeek-V4-Flash") %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant_ID, all_of(Eng_q_names))

lowcost_scores <- llms_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(Rater == "LLMs_mean") %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant_ID, all_of(Eng_q_names))

primary_scores <- primary_llms_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(Rater == "Primary_LLMs_mean") %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant_ID, all_of(Eng_q_names))

icc_deepseek_primary <- compute_icc_pair(deepseek_scores, primary_scores, Eng_q_names) %>%
  mutate(Rater = "DeepSeek-V4-Flash")

icc_lowcost_primary <- compute_icc_pair(lowcost_scores, primary_scores, Eng_q_names) %>%
  mutate(Rater = "Low-cost LLM mean")

icc_compare <- bind_rows(icc_deepseek_primary, icc_lowcost_primary)
```

```{r}
# 跟corr_compare用同一套Category/Dimension排序规则，两张图的行顺序/分类完全对齐
add_category_dim_factor <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Category = case_when(
        Dimension %in% c("interoceptive", "internally focused", "externally focused") ~ "Perceptual Orientation",
        Dimension %in% c("self focused", "other focused") ~ "Social Dimension",
        Dimension %in% c("past", "present", "future") ~ "Temporal Dimension",
        Dimension %in% c("positive", "negative") ~ "Valence",
        Dimension %in% c("problem solving", "reflection", "rumination", "rating of depression") ~ "Thinking Style",
        TRUE ~ "Emotional Experience"
      ),
      Category  = factor(Category, levels = category_levels_corr),
      Dimension = factor(str_to_sentence(Dimension), levels = rev(str_to_sentence(dim_order_all)))
    )
}

icc_compare <- add_category_dim_factor(icc_compare)

write_xlsx(icc_compare, "D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/draft/mini/0930icc_compare_2raters.xlsx")
```

#3个LLM
```{r}
# 只保留3个LLM的数据（去掉human和LLMs_mean）
llms_data <- llm_analysis2 %>%
  filter(Rater %in% llm_raters2)

# 对每个维度计算LLMs之间的ICC
icc_between_llms <- map_dfr(Eng_q_names, function(q) {

  # 宽格式：行=被试，列=各LLM
  wide <- llms_data %>%
    dplyr::select(Participant_ID, Rater, all_of(q)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Rater, values_from = all_of(q)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Participant_ID) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  # 计算ICC
  result <- icc(wide, model = "twoway", type = "agreement", unit = "average")
  
  tibble(
    Dimension = q,
    ICC       = result$value,
    p_value   = result$p.value, 
    ICC_lower = result$lbound,
    ICC_upper = result$ubound
  )
})
```

#humans ICC
```{r}
humans_raw_data <- read.xlsx("D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/human_raters_raw.xlsx")

E_q_names <- c("rating of depression", "interoceptive", "internally focused", "externally focused", "self focused", "other focused", "positive", "negative", "problem solving", "guilt", "concern", "anger", "disgust", "fear", "sadness", "surprise", "happiness", "liking", "pleasure", "self-abasement", "disappointment", "past", "future", "present", "reflection", "rumination")

names(humans_raw_data)[4:ncol(humans_raw_data)] <- E_q_names
```


```{r}
icc_human <- map_dfr(E_q_names, function(q) {
  
  wide <- humans_raw_data %>%
    dplyr::select(Participant_ID, rater, all_of(q)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = rater, values_from = all_of(q)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Participant_ID) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%  # 确保数值型
    na.omit()
  
  # 用oneway，因为评分者是随机分配的，不是固定的同一批人
  result <- icc(wide, model = "twoway", type = "agreement", unit = "average")
  
  tibble(
    Dimension = q,
    ICC       = result$value,
    p_value   = result$p.value,
    ICC_lower = result$lbound,
    ICC_upper = result$ubound
  )
})

# E_q_names 里是 "like"，Eng_q_names/icc_between_llms 里是 "liking"，统一成 "liking" 以便和LLM的ICC结果按维度对齐
```


```{r}
write_xlsx(icc_human, "icc_human.xlsx")
```


```{r}
# LLM ICC vs 人类 ICC 散点图：每个点为一个维度，x=LLM评分者间ICC，y=人类评分者间ICC
# 加对角线 y=x 作为参考：点越靠右上=双方都容易评；越靠左下=双方都难评；
# 偏离对角线越远=LLM和人类的评分者一致性差异越大（右下=人类一致而LLM分歧大，左上=LLM反而更一致）
icc_scatter_data <- icc_between_llms %>%
  dplyr::select(Dimension, ICC_llm = ICC) %>%
  inner_join(
    icc_human %>% dplyr::select(Dimension, ICC_human = ICC),
    by = "Dimension"
  )

# 按你的6类维度分组，rating of depression单独作为第7类（空心圆+黑色）
category_levels <- c(
  "Perceptual Orientation", "Social Dimension", "Temporal Dimension",
  "Valence", "Thinking Style", "Emotional Experience", "Rating of Depression"
)

icc_scatter_data <- icc_scatter_data %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      Dimension == "rating of depression" ~ "Rating of Depression",
      Dimension %in% c("interoceptive", "internally focused", "externally focused") ~ "Perceptual Orientation",
      Dimension %in% c("self focused", "other focused") ~ "Social Dimension",
      Dimension %in% c("past", "present", "future") ~ "Temporal Dimension",
      Dimension %in% c("positive", "negative") ~ "Valence",
      Dimension %in% c("problem solving", "reflection", "rumination") ~ "Thinking Style",
      TRUE ~ "Emotional Experience"
    ),
    Category = factor(Category, levels = category_levels)
  )

category_colors <- c(
  "Perceptual Orientation" = "#2a78d6",
  "Social Dimension"       = "#1baf7a",
  "Temporal Dimension"     = "#eda100",
  "Valence"                = "#e87ba4",
  "Thinking Style"         = "#4a3aa7",
  "Emotional Experience"   = "#7B3F00",
  "Rating of Depression"   = "#0b0b0b"
)

category_shapes <- c(
  "Perceptual Orientation" = 16,  # 实心圆
  "Social Dimension"       = 17,  # 实心三角
  "Temporal Dimension"     = 15,  # 实心方块
  "Valence"                = 18,  # 实心菱形
  "Thinking Style"         = 8,   # 星号
  "Emotional Experience"   = 1,   # 空心圆（棕色）
  "Rating of Depression"   = 1    # 空心圆
)

# 标签左右交替：随机抽一半维度的标签放左边，其余放右边
set.seed(123)
n_dim     <- nrow(icc_scatter_data)
left_dims <- sample(icc_scatter_data$Dimension, size = floor(n_dim / 2))

# 这些维度只保留棕色空心圆圈，不显示标签文字
no_label_dims <- c("problem solving", "disgust", "fear", "liking", "disappointment",
                    "pleasure", "guilt", "sadness", "anger", "rumination", "happiness",
                    "concern")

icc_scatter_data <- icc_scatter_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_side = if_else(Dimension %in% left_dims, "left", "right"),
    # 手动指定放左侧
    label_side = if_else(Dimension %in% c("negative"), "left", label_side),
    # 手动指定放右侧
    label_side = if_else(Dimension %in% c("future", "reflection"), "right", label_side),
    # 手动指定放左侧
    label_side = if_else(Dimension %in% c("surprise", "internally focused"), "left", label_side),
    hide_label = Dimension %in% no_label_dims
  )

# 标签与点之间的固定间距（数据坐标单位，和文字长短无关，可按需调整）
label_gap <- 0.02

p_icc_scatter <- ggplot(icc_scatter_data, aes(x = ICC_llm, y = ICC_human)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5,  linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.75, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5,  linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(aes(color = Category, shape = Category), size = 5) +
  geom_text(data = filter(icc_scatter_data, !hide_label, label_side == "left"),
            aes(label = Dimension), hjust = 1, nudge_x = -label_gap,
            size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = filter(icc_scatter_data, !hide_label, label_side == "right"),
            aes(label = Dimension), hjust = 0, nudge_x = label_gap,
            size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = category_colors, breaks = category_levels) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = category_shapes, breaks = category_levels) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.4, 1, 0.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0.4, 0.9, 0.1)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(0.4, 1), ylim = c(0.4, 0.9), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "LLM ICC", y = "Human ICC", color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text          = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title         = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.justification = 0.4,
    legend.key.size    = unit(1.0, "cm"),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin        = margin(t = 5, r = 60, b = 5, l = 5)
  )

p_icc_scatter
```


```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "mini_ICC_LLM_vs_Human_scatter2.png",
  plot     = p_icc_scatter,
  width    = 10,
  height   = 9,
  dpi      = 300
)
```

#internally/externally focused：Human vs LLMs_mean 相关系数，按MDD/HC分组分别计算
```{r}
# 复用前面已经定义好的 compute_r()，只是把输入数据先按Group切分，
# 分别在HC和MDD子集内部计算 Human vs LLMs_mean 的Pearson r（不跨组混算）
dims_target <- c("internally focused", "externally focused")

group_levels <- llms_analysis %>%
  filter(Rater == "Human") %>%
  distinct(Group) %>%
  pull(Group)

corr_llmsmean_by_group <- map_dfr(group_levels, function(g) {
  data_g <- llms_analysis %>% filter(Group == g)

  human_g <- data_g %>%
    filter(Rater == "Human") %>%
    select(Participant_ID, all_of(dims_target))

  compute_r(data_g, "LLMs_mean", human_g, dims_target) %>%
    mutate(Group = g) %>%
    relocate(Group, .before = Dimension)
})

# 组内单独做FDR校正（2个维度 x 各组内部作为一个family）
corr_llmsmean_by_group <- corr_llmsmean_by_group %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"), sig_fdr = p_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  ungroup()

corr_llmsmean_by_group
```

```{r}
write_xlsx(corr_llmsmean_by_group, "D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/mini_corr_llmsmean_internally_externally_by_group.xlsx")
```
